_comment: Schema per entry: pack (str, display name of the style pack e.g. 'Warm Minimal'), title (str, caption for this specific image), area_kind (str, one of the AreaKind enum values in app/models/profiler.py — currently 'interior' | 'house_build' | 'element'), area_key (str|null, a room key like 'kitchen'/'master_bedroom'/'facade', or null to offer this image for ANY area of that area_kind), file (str, path to the image relative to THIS manifest's directory — put real images in a '<pack-slug>/' subdirectory, e.g. 'warm-minimal/oak-stone.jpg'). Run: python -m scripts.seed_profiler_presets --from-dir assets/presets — idempotent, safe to re-run per batch. The images below are tiny placeholder gradients checked in so the manifest is runnable out of the box; replace them with real licensed photos (see README.md in this directory) before using this catalog for real.
